description: Earth Radio local media and AI assistance provenance
development: Codex assisted coding, design research and review. Claude independently audited an older snapshot, as recorded in AUDIT.md.
narration: Twelve pre-generated ElevenLabs host narration clips using four synthetic voices, normalized and limited in the existing build. MP3 tags were added with stream copy; the encoded audio hashes below matched before and after.
music: Procedural Web Audio synthesis at runtime from rendered NASA image pixels; no generated audio service is called for music.
nasa_media: NASA-provided source imagery, resized, clipped, compressed and projected as documented in README.md and visual-resolution.json. Not AI-generated. NASA does not endorse Earth Radio.
demo_frame: assets/demo-black-marble-frame.png is an extracted frame at 5 seconds of the bundled assets/nightmap.mp4 (NASA SVS 5475); the video itself is a compressed excerpt. No generative modification.
licenses: The Apache 2.0 software license does not cover NASA media, ElevenLabs audio or OFL fonts; see README.md for the separate credits and terms.
typography: User-supplied Helvetica Regular and Bold from helvetica-255.zip. Original font files copied without modification for this local preview. See assets/fonts/Helvetica-NOTICE.txt; no license document was included in the archive.
